title: The spacecraft that flew farther than any human vehicle
description: In 2022, the Artemis I mission sent an uncrewed Orion capsule on a record-breaking journey around the Moon. This flight tested the heat shield and systems that will soon carry astronauts back to the lunar surface.

shots.narration: On 16 November 2022, Orion launched, filming the Moon and Earth shown here together.
The spacecraft flew for 25.5 days after launching atop the most powerful rocket ever to fly at the time.
It traveled farther than any spacecraft built for people, reaching 432,000 km from Earth.
In the commander's seat, a mannequin nicknamed Commander Moonikin Campos sat wired with sensors.
Cameras on the solar arrays filmed the Earth and Moon together during the uncrewed flight.
After 25.5 days in space, the capsule began its flight back into the atmosphere.
The vehicle traveled at about 40,000 km/h as it returned into the atmosphere.
The heat shield reached around 2,800 °C while the Moon and Earth remained in view.
On 11 December 2022, the capsule splashed down in the Pacific Ocean to complete its flight.
